method: Exact source unit cubes merged only as contiguous same-x,z y runs. Rotation is absolute game angle; z invariant. Static triangle surfaces clipped exactly to moving prism z slab then projected to XY. Continuous interval swept OBB contains corner trajectories: convex hull endpoint+midpoint with outward sagitta r*delta^2/8, circumscribed numerical buffer. Recursive disjointness proof; midpoint positive-area intersection witnesses. Body union of occupied unit cubes. Central <=8 voxel-radius source boxes against body are quantified attachments, never removes noncentral or model contacts. Mesh-interior containment without surface crossing is not certified.
